cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31)

project(nlohmann_json VERSION 3.12.0)
message(STATUS "nlohmann_json version: ${PROJECT_VERSION}")

file(GLOB_RECURSE HEADERS *.h *.hpp)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} INTERFACE)
add_library(TG::${PROJECT_NAME} ALIAS ${PROJECT_NAME})

include(GNUInstallDirs)

target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME}
    INTERFACE
    JSON_USE_GLOBAL_UDLS=1
    JSON_USE_IMPLICIT_CONVERSIONS=1
    JSON_DISABLE_ENUM_SERIALIZATION=0
    JSON_DIAGNOSTICS=0
    JSON_DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIONS=0
    JSON_USE_LEGACY_DISCARDED_VALUE_COMPARISON=0
)
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} SYSTEM
    INTERFACE
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Public>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}>
)

include(TGInstall)
tg_install(
    ${PROJECT_NAME}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
    ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)
